title: Access codes
description: The incoming-message views you can read. Open one to see its current codes and its history.
caption: Access code views
col.name: View
empty.title: You have no views yet
empty.description: When someone shares a code view with you, it will appear here.
view.title: Code view
view.description: Current codes and receipt history of this view.
view.descriptionWithSource: Source: {{source}}. Current codes and receipt history.
codes.heading: Current codes
codes.description: Each code hides itself when it expires. It is not saved in the browser.
codes.expired: Code {{position}} expired and was hidden. Refresh to check for a new one.
codes.clipboardNote: If you copy it, the clipboard is cleared {{seconds}} seconds later (best effort, not a guarantee).
codes.empty.title: There are no current codes
codes.empty.description: When a message with a code arrives, it will appear here. Press "Refresh codes" to check again.
history.heading: Receipt history
history.description: The messages that matched this view, newest first. It does not include the codes.
history.caption: Receipt history of the view
history.empty.title: No receipts yet
history.empty.description: When a message that matches this view arrives, it will appear here.
resets.heading: Resets
resets.description: The codes and links to reset the account's access. Revealing them requires a reason, is audited and alerts Root.
resets.warning: Revealing a reset lets someone take over the account. It is recorded with your reason and Root is alerted.
resets.none: There are no live resets in this view. The attempt was recorded.
resets.hidden: The resets were hidden. To see them again you will need to give a reason again.
sources.title: Code sources
sources.description: The mailboxes that receive the messages with codes. Here you can add, rename and archive them.
sources.caption: Code sources
sources.col.name: Name
sources.empty.title: There are no sources yet
sources.empty.description: Add a mailbox to start receiving codes.
sources.form.addressHelp: The mailbox the messages with codes arrive in.
sources.form.name: Name
sources.create.title: Add source
sources.create.description: Register the mailbox that will receive the codes and give it a name.
sources.rename.title: Rename source {{name}}
sources.rename.description: Only the name changes; the address stays the same.
sources.archive.title: Archive source {{name}}?
sources.archive.description: The source will stop receiving codes and its views will no longer be shown.
sources.connection.title: Mailbox connection for {{name}}
sources.connection.description: The IMAP server the codes are read from. The password is never shown.
sources.connection.hostHelp: Server name, for example imap.example.com. IP addresses are not accepted.
sources.connection.tlsModeHelp: The port is set by the security type.
sources.connection.authservIdHelp: Name the mail server writes in the Authentication-Results header, for example mx.example.com. Only that header is trusted.
sources.connection.recipientsHelp: Exact addresses, separated by commas. Up to 10.
sources.connection.recipientsManageOnly: Only a source manager can change them.
sources.connection.passwordKeep: A password is stored. Leave this empty to keep it.
sources.connection.clearsPassword: You changed the server, security or user: unless you enter the password, the stored one will be deleted.
sources.connection.toast: The connection of source {{name}} was saved.
